POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Swathi Menon | Age: 54
Body Temperature at Scene: 22.8°C | Ambient Temperature: 28.3°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 13.0 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  2. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  3. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  4. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Chloroform, Benzodiazepines

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
